strings.About.Title: About PerceptoX
strings.About.Author: Author: Prepelita Eduard
strings.About.Description: PerceptoX helps identify original photos from thumbnails, crops or screenshots. Compare matches visually, group nearly identical copies and copy selected images to a folder of your choice.
strings.About.License: Free application with GPL-3.0-only sources. Dependencies retain their own licenses.

strings.SettingsPage.Text001: Adjust searches, calibrate results and manage storage.
strings.SettingsPage.Text005: The language changes immediately. Your folders, results and selections are preserved.
strings.SettingsPage.Text007: PerceptoX helps you find original images in a local library. Choose the reference folder and the library, start the search, compare matches side by side and copy the selected originals to a folder of your choice.
strings.SettingsPage.Text008: References can be thumbnails, resized versions, crops, or screenshots. Matches are estimates: check them visually. The search does not modify the originals, and recoverable archiving requires separate confirmation.
strings.SettingsPage.Text009: Free application, with GPL-3.0-only sources. Respect third-party dependency licenses.
strings.SettingsPage.Text010: For a new language, add a JSON catalog in the languages folder and restart the application. Missing keys use Romanian.
strings.SettingsPage.Text013: Limit the number of matches displayed for each reference image.
strings.SettingsPage.Text016: A smaller distance is stricter. High values can bring more results, but also false matches.
strings.SettingsPage.Text023: Calibration uses previously labeled and saved examples. Thumbnails, crops and variants of the same photo are grouped by original family.
strings.SettingsPage.Text024: Original family for the following labels
strings.SettingsPage.Text026: The results list no longer includes labeling buttons. Existing examples are preserved; proposing new thresholds requires enough valid examples.
strings.SettingsPage.Text028: Minimum: 100/40 training/holdout pairs, 10/5 references and 20 positive plus 20 negative in each partition. The proposal is not applied automatically.
strings.SettingsPage.Text039: Keep index; thumbnails regenerate on display. Original photos are not affected.
strings.SettingsPage.Text042: Delete index and thumbnails. A new indexing will be required. Original photos are not deleted.
strings.SettingsPage.Text045: Only CSV/HTML generated by PerceptoX and marked for cleaning are deleted from the selected folder.
strings.SettingsPage.Text046: Choose the folder and clean the reports
strings.SettingsPage.Text050: Included in the standalone distribution. Does not require global installations and updates with the application.
strings.SettingsPage.Text052: Installation, repair, and update of modules require confirmation. A new module is activated after restarting PerceptoX.

strings.Calibration.Warning.Metrics: Metrics describe labeled holdout pairs only; they are not match probabilities or whole-library recall.
